purpose: Understand the basic principles of Japanese interior design and spatial planning, including simplicity, natural materials, open space, light, balance, and functional room arrangements. The level helps learners become familiar with key Japanese design ideas and how they can be applied to simple interior spaces.
purpose_jp: シンプルさ、自然素材、オープンスペース、光、バランス、機能的な部屋の配置など、日本のインテリアデザインと空間計画の基本原則を理解します。 このレベルは、学習者が重要な日本のデザインアイデアと、それらをシンプルなインテリア空間にどのように適用できるかに習熟するのに役立ち
learn_info: Learn the basic ideas of Japanese interior design and spatial planning, including simplicity, balance, natural materials, light, open space, and functionality. Learners study how rooms are organized, how furniture affects movement, and how empty space can be used effectively. The level introduces common Japanese interior elements, basic proportions, natural colors, simple forms, and the relationship between indoor and outdoor spaces. Learners also explore basic planning methods for living rooms, bedrooms, dining areas, and other residential spaces. Simple exercises help learners understand how to create calm and practical layouts while considering everyday activities, comfort, and available space.
outcome: Learners will be able to plan simple Japanese-inspired interiors using basic principles of space, light, natural materials, furniture placement, balance, and everyday functionality.
outcome_jp: 学習者は、空間、光、自然素材、家具の配置、バランス、日常の機能性の基本原則を使用して、シンプルな日本風のインテリアを計画することができます。

purpose: Develop the ability to apply Japanese interior design principles to residential spaces by planning room layouts, selecting suitable materials, arranging furniture, and considering lighting, circulation, and everyday use. The level focuses on turning basic design knowledge into practical interior planning decisions.
purpose_jp: 部屋のレイアウトを計画し、適切な材料を選択し、家具を配置し、照明、循環、日常使用を考慮することにより、日本のインテリアデザインの原則を住宅空間に適用する能力を開発します。 レベルは、実用的なインテリア計画の決定に基本的な設計知識を回すことに焦点を当てています。
learn_info: Learn how to apply Japanese interior design principles to complete residential spaces through practical planning and design decisions. Learners study furniture arrangement, circulation, storage, lighting, material combinations, color balance, proportions, and connections between different rooms. The level also introduces natural light, visual simplicity, flexible space, and the careful use of decorative elements. Learners work with basic floor plans and design references to develop more organized interior concepts. They learn how to adapt Japanese design ideas to modern lifestyles while maintaining a balanced and functional atmosphere. Practical projects help learners improve their ability to plan rooms and make independent choices about layout, materials, furniture, and lighting.
outcome: Learners will be able to create complete residential layouts using Japanese design principles while making practical decisions about furniture, lighting, storage, materials, circulation, and room relationships.
outcome_jp: 学習者は、家具、照明、保管、材料、循環、部屋の関係について実践的な意思決定を行いながら、日本のデザイン原則を使用して完全な住宅のレイアウトを作成することができます。

purpose: Build advanced skills in developing complete Japanese-inspired interior concepts with greater attention to spatial relationships, material combinations, proportions, lighting, functionality, and connection with nature. Learners are expected to make independent design decisions and refine their concepts for more complex residential or hospitality spaces.
purpose_jp: 空間的な関係性、素材の組み合わせ、プロポーション、照明、機能性、自然とのつながりに大きな注意を払って、日本風のインテリアコンセプトを完全に開発するための高度なスキルを構築します。 学習者は、独立した設計上の決定を行い、より複雑な住宅やホスピタリティスペースのための彼らの概念を洗練することが期待されています。
learn_info: Learn advanced methods for developing complete Japanese-inspired interior concepts for more complex residential and hospitality spaces. Learners study detailed spatial relationships, circulation, proportions, material combinations, lighting strategies, furniture placement, storage solutions, and the connection between architecture and nature. The level explores how traditional Japanese ideas can be interpreted within contemporary interiors without relying on surface decoration alone. Learners examine private and shared spaces, transitions between rooms, visual rhythm, and the use of natural materials. Project work focuses on developing complete concepts, refining floor plans, selecting materials, creating mood boards, and explaining design decisions clearly through professional presentations.
outcome: Learners will be able to develop detailed Japanese-inspired interior concepts for complex spaces, combining spatial planning, materials, lighting, furniture, proportions, and indoor-outdoor relationships.
outcome_jp: 学習者は、空間計画、材料、照明、家具、プロポーション、屋内と屋外の関係を組み合わせて、複雑な空間のための詳細な日本風のインテリアコンセプトを開発することができます。

purpose: Develop expert-level ability to create sophisticated Japanese-inspired spatial concepts while balancing cultural references, contemporary requirements, material quality, functionality, and visual identity. The level prepares learners to lead complex interior projects, develop original design directions, and make high-level creative and spatial decisions.
purpose_jp: 文化的な参照、現代的な要件、材料の品質、機能性、視覚的アイデンティティのバランスをとりながら、洗練された日本風の空間概念を作成する専門家レ レベルは、複雑なインテリアプロジェクトをリードし、オリジナルのデザインの方向性を開発し、高レベルの創造的で空間的な意思決定を行うために学習者を準備します。
learn_info: Develop expert-level knowledge for creating sophisticated Japanese-inspired interior and spatial design projects with a strong understanding of space, culture, materials, functionality, and contemporary living. Learners study how to develop original design directions rather than simply copying traditional Japanese interiors. Topics include complex spatial planning, material detailing, lighting concepts, indoor-outdoor relationships, custom furniture, cultural references, and high-level design refinement. Learners work with demanding project requirements and make independent decisions about atmosphere, function, proportions, and visual identity. The level also focuses on presenting a complete design concept clearly through plans, material selections, visual references, and professional documentation while maintaining a thoughtful connection between Japanese design principles and modern spatial needs.
outcome: Learners will be able to develop original and sophisticated Japanese-inspired interiors, making professional decisions about spatial planning, materials, cultural references, functionality, atmosphere, and contemporary design requirements.
outcome_jp: 学習者は、空間計画、材料、文化的参照、機能性、雰囲気、現代的なデザイン要件について専門的な意思決定を行い、オリジナルで洗練された日本風のインテリアを開発することができます。

purpose: Understand the basic principles of sustainable architecture, including responsible material selection, energy efficiency, natural light, ventilation, water use, and environmental considerations. The level introduces learners to the main factors that influence the sustainability and long-term performance of buildings.
purpose_jp: 責任ある材料の選択、エネルギー効率、自然光、換気、水の使用、環境への配慮など、持続可能な建築の基本原則を理解します。 このレベルでは、建物の持続可能性と長期的なパフォーマンスに影響を与える主な要因を学習者に紹介します。
learn_info: Learn the foundations of sustainable architecture, including energy efficiency, natural lighting, ventilation, water use, responsible material selection, durability, and environmental impact. Learners study how site conditions, climate, building orientation, and basic construction choices can influence the performance of a building. The level introduces common sustainable design approaches and helps learners understand the relationship between environmental responsibility, comfort, and architectural appearance. Learners also examine basic material properties and why some materials may be more suitable for particular projects. Simple examples and exercises help learners recognize sustainability opportunities during the early stages of architectural planning and understand how practical design decisions can reduce resource use while supporting comfortable and useful buildings.
outcome: Learners will be able to identify basic sustainable architecture principles and understand how materials, climate, energy, lighting, ventilation, water, and site conditions affect building performance.
outcome_jp: 学習者は、基本的な持続可能な建築の原則を特定し、材料、気候、エネルギー、照明、換気、水、および敷地条件が建物のパフォーマンスにどのように影響するかを理解することができます。

purpose: Develop the ability to apply sustainable design principles to architectural projects by comparing materials, considering site conditions, improving energy performance, and making practical decisions about building systems and resources. The level focuses on applying sustainability during the design process.
purpose_jp: 材料の比較、敷地条件の検討、エネルギー性能の向上、建築システムと資源に関する実践的な意思決定により、建築プロジェクトに持続可能な設計原則を適用する能力を開発する。 このレベルでは、設計プロセス中に持続可能性を適用することに焦点を当てています。
learn_info: Learn how to apply sustainable architecture principles to real building concepts by considering materials, site conditions, energy use, natural light, ventilation, water, and occupant comfort. Learners study how different materials can affect durability, maintenance, environmental impact, and overall building performance. The level introduces methods for comparing design options and making practical decisions based on project requirements. Learners also explore passive design strategies, climate response, building orientation, shading, and the relationship between indoor and outdoor conditions. Through practical exercises and project work, learners develop the ability to include sustainability during planning rather than treating it as an additional feature. The focus is on creating balanced architectural solutions that are environmentally responsible, functional, comfortable, and realistic.
outcome: Learners will be able to apply sustainable design principles when selecting materials, planning spaces, considering climate, improving energy performance, and balancing environmental responsibility with comfort and practical requirements.
outcome_jp: 学習者は、材料を選択し、スペースを計画し、気候を考慮し、エネルギー性能を改善し、快適さと実用的な要件と環境責任のバランスをとるときに、持続可能な設計原則を適用することができます。

purpose: Build advanced skills in developing architectural concepts that integrate environmental performance, material efficiency, climate response, energy use, durability, and occupant comfort. Learners develop the ability to evaluate different design solutions and make informed sustainability decisions for more complex projects.
purpose_jp: 環境性能、材料効率、気候応答、エネルギー使用、耐久性、乗員の快適性を統合する建築概念の開発における高度なスキルを構築します。 学習者は、さまざまな設計ソリューションを評価し、より複雑なプロジェクトに対して情報に基づいた持続可能性の決定を行う能力を開発します。
learn_info: Learn advanced sustainable architecture methods for developing building concepts that respond to environmental conditions, resource use, material performance, energy efficiency, and long-term building needs. Learners examine more complex relationships between climate, site, orientation, building form, natural systems, materials, and occupant comfort. The level covers strategies for reducing energy demand, improving passive performance, selecting appropriate materials, and considering durability and maintenance. Learners also study how sustainability can influence architectural form and spatial organization rather than being limited to technical systems. Project exercises require learners to compare alternatives, evaluate trade-offs, and justify their design choices. The focus is on creating integrated architectural concepts that balance environmental performance, functionality, aesthetics, cost, and long-term use.
outcome: Learners will be able to develop integrated sustainable architectural concepts that consider environmental performance, material efficiency, climate response, energy use, durability, comfort, and long-term building requirements.
outcome_jp: 学習者の動きを統合持続可能な建築の概念に配慮した環境性能、材料の効率、気候変動、エネルギー使用、耐久性、快適性、長期的なビル。

purpose: Develop expert-level ability to lead sustainable architectural design decisions across complex projects while balancing environmental goals, technical requirements, cost, aesthetics, durability, and user comfort. The level focuses on developing strong professional judgment and integrated sustainable design strategies.
purpose_jp: 環境目標、技術要件、コスト、美しさ、耐久性、ユーザーの快適さのバランスをとりながら、複雑なプロジェクト全体で持続可能な建築設計の決定を導く専門家レ レベルは、強力な専門的判断と統合された持続可能な設計戦略の開発に焦点を当てています。
learn_info: Learn advanced professional approaches to sustainable architecture by developing complete design strategies for complex projects. Learners study how to coordinate environmental goals with architectural form, material systems, building performance, user requirements, cost, durability, and project constraints. Topics include integrated passive design, advanced material selection, climate-responsive planning, resource efficiency, lifecycle thinking, and the relationship between environmental performance and architectural identity. Learners practice evaluating competing design solutions and making informed decisions when different requirements conflict. Expert-level project work focuses on developing original sustainable strategies that can guide an entire architectural project rather than isolated improvements. Learners also develop the ability to communicate environmental decisions clearly through professional drawings, design documentation, material studies, and project presentations.
outcome: Learners will be able to develop professional sustainable design strategies for complex architectural projects while balancing environmental performance, technical requirements, aesthetics, cost, durability, comfort, and resource efficiency.
outcome_jp: 学習者が専門的な持続可能なデザイン戦略のための複雑な建築プロジェクトのバランスをとりつつ、環境性能、技術的要件、美学、コスト、耐久性、快適性、資源の効率。

purpose: Understand the basic elements of residential interior design, including room layouts, furniture placement, storage, lighting, colors, materials, proportions, and circulation. The level helps learners understand how interior spaces are organized around everyday activities and household needs.
purpose_jp: 部屋のレイアウト、家具の配置、貯蔵、照明、色、材料、割合、および循環を含む住宅のインテリア-デザインの基本的な要素を、理解しなさい。 このレベルは、学習者が日常の活動や家庭のニーズを中心に内部空間がどのように組織されているかを理解するのに役立ちます。
learn_info: Learn the basic principles of residential interior design, including room planning, furniture placement, circulation, storage, lighting, colors, materials, proportions, and functionality. Learners study how different rooms support everyday activities and how interior elements can be arranged to create comfortable and practical living spaces. The level introduces common residential areas such as living rooms, bedrooms, kitchens, dining spaces, bathrooms, and work areas. Learners explore basic floor plans and simple furniture layouts while learning how to consider the size and shape of a room. They also study how color, lighting, and materials can influence the atmosphere of a home. Simple planning exercises help learners develop an understanding of how individual design decisions work together within a residential interior.
outcome: Learners will be able to create basic residential layouts by applying principles of space planning, furniture placement, circulation, storage, lighting, color, materials, proportions, and everyday household requirements.
outcome_jp: 学習者は、空間計画、家具の配置、循環、保管、照明、色、材料、比率、および日常の家庭の要件の原則を適用することによって、基本的な住宅のレイアウトを作

purpose: Develop the ability to plan complete residential interiors based on user requirements, available space, room relationships, furniture needs, lighting, storage, and material choices. Learners begin making independent design decisions and creating practical layouts for different types of homes.
purpose_jp: ユーザーの要求、利用可能なスペース、部屋の関係、家具の必要性、照明、貯蔵および材料の選択に基づいて完全な住宅の内部を計画する機能を開発しなさい。 学習者は独立した設計決定を行い、さまざまなタイプの家のための実用的なレイアウトを作成し始めます。
learn_info: Learn how to develop practical residential interiors based on user needs, available space, lifestyle, storage requirements, furniture, lighting, materials, and room relationships. Learners study how to organize complete floor plans and create better connections between different areas of a home. The level introduces more detailed planning methods, including zoning, circulation, furniture dimensions, lighting placement, color selection, and material coordination. Learners practice adapting layouts to different types of homes and different household requirements. They also explore how design choices can improve comfort and make everyday activities easier. Project work helps learners move from simple room arrangements to complete residential concepts while developing the ability to explain their design decisions through plans, visual references, material selections, and organized presentations.
outcome: Learners will be able to develop practical residential interiors based on user needs, available space, lifestyle, furniture, storage, lighting, materials, and relationships between different rooms.
outcome_jp: 学習者は、ユーザーのニーズ、利用可能なスペース、ライフスタイル、家具、収納、照明、材料、および異なる部屋間の関係に基づいて、実用的な住宅インテリアを開発

purpose: Build advanced residential interior design skills through more complex planning, detailed material selection, lighting strategies, space optimization, and coordination between different rooms. The level focuses on developing cohesive interior concepts that respond to both functional and visual requirements.
purpose_jp: より複雑な計画、詳細な材料選択、照明戦略、空間最適化、および異なる部屋間の調整を通じて、高度な住宅インテリアデザインのスキルを構築します。 レベルは機能および視覚条件に答える凝集の内部の概念の開発に焦点を合わせる。
learn_info: Learn advanced residential interior design through complex space planning, detailed material selection, lighting strategies, furniture coordination, storage planning, and development of cohesive interior concepts. Learners study how multiple rooms can be designed as one connected environment while still responding to the specific function of each space. The level covers more detailed client requirements, spatial limitations, circulation challenges, custom furniture considerations, and relationships between materials and lighting. Learners work on larger residential projects where several design decisions must be coordinated at the same time. They also develop stronger presentation methods through floor plans, elevations, material boards, furniture selections, and visual concepts. The focus is on producing refined residential interiors that balance functionality, comfort, visual quality, and the needs of the people using the space.
outcome: Learners will be able to design detailed residential interiors with coordinated layouts, materials, lighting, furniture, storage, and architectural elements while responding to more complex client and spatial requirements.
outcome_jp: 学習者はより複雑な顧客および空間的な条件に答えている間調整されたレイアウト、材料、照明、家具、貯蔵および建築要素の詳しい住宅の内部を設計

purpose: Develop expert-level ability to create complete residential design directions for complex projects, balancing client needs, spatial limitations, aesthetics, functionality, materials, and long-term use. The level prepares learners to make professional design decisions and develop distinctive residential interiors.
purpose_jp: 複雑なプロジェクトのための完全な住宅の設計方向を作成する専門家レベルの機能を開発し、顧客の必要性、空間的な限定、美学、機能性、材料および長期使用のバランスをとる。 レベルは、プロの設計上の決定を行い、独特の住宅のインテリアを開発するために学習者を準備します。
learn_info: Learn how to develop complete residential design directions for complex projects while balancing client requirements, spatial limitations, lifestyle, functionality, materials, lighting, furniture, and visual identity. Learners study advanced approaches to creating distinctive interiors that are practical as well as visually consistent. Topics include complex space planning, custom elements, detailed material relationships, lighting concepts, transitions between rooms, storage solutions, and integration of architectural features. Learners work with demanding project conditions and make independent decisions about priorities, atmosphere, proportion, and long-term usability. Expert-level work focuses on developing a complete residential design language from the initial concept through detailed planning and presentation. Learners also refine their ability to communicate and defend design decisions through professional documentation and project presentations.
outcome: Learners will be able to develop complete residential design directions for complex projects, balancing client needs, functionality, spatial limitations, materials, lighting, furniture, comfort, and visual identity.
outcome_jp: 学習者は、クライアントのニーズ、機能性、空間的制限、材料、照明、家具、快適さ、および視覚的アイデンティティのバランスをとりながら、複雑なプロジェクトのための完全な住宅設計の方向性を開発することができます。

purpose: Understand the basic principles of 3D architectural visualization, including digital modeling, materials, textures, lighting, cameras, composition, and simple rendering. The level introduces learners to how architectural drawings and ideas can be transformed into understandable three-dimensional visuals.
purpose_jp: 基本原則を理解するとともに3Dの建築の可視化を含むデジタルモデリング、素材の質感、照明、カメラの構成と簡単なレンダリング のレベルを紹介す学習者はどのように建築図面やアイディア化することができや立体化します。
learn_info: Learn the basic principles of 3D architectural visualization, including digital modeling, simple materials, textures, lighting, cameras, composition, and rendering. Learners study how architectural plans and design ideas can be transformed into basic three-dimensional spaces. The level introduces the main stages of a visualization workflow, from creating simple geometry to applying materials and setting up a camera. Learners explore how scale, proportions, and accurate dimensions affect the quality of a model. They also study basic lighting and composition so that the final image clearly communicates the intended space. Simple practice projects help learners become familiar with the process of building and presenting architectural or interior scenes while developing an understanding of how digital visualization supports design communication.
outcome: Learners will be able to create basic 3D architectural models and visualizations using simple modeling, materials, textures, lighting, camera settings, composition, and rendering techniques.
outcome_jp: 学習者は、シンプルなモデリング、マテリアル、テクスチャ、ライティング、カメラ設定、コンポジション、レンダリング技術を使用して、基本的な3D建築モデルとビジュアライゼーションを作成することができます。

purpose: Develop the ability to create organized 3D models and visual presentations of architectural and interior spaces using appropriate modeling, materials, lighting, camera positions, and composition. The level focuses on producing clear visuals that communicate design ideas effectively.
purpose_jp: 開発の能力を組織3次元モデルとビューの建築及び室内空間に適切なモデリング、材料、照明、カメラ位置します。 のレベルを製造明確なビジュアルに伝えるデザインアイデアを効果的に
learn_info: Learn how to create organized 3D models and architectural visualizations using more detailed modeling, materials, textures, lighting, camera positioning, and composition. Learners study how to build interior and exterior scenes accurately from architectural information and how to present spaces in a clear visual format. The level introduces more detailed material setup, natural and artificial lighting, camera framing, scene organization, and basic rendering refinement. Learners also explore how visualization choices can support the original design instead of changing its intended appearance. Project work helps learners create complete scenes that can be used for design reviews, client presentations, portfolios, and project communication. The focus is on improving accuracy, visual quality, organization, and consistency throughout the visualization process.
outcome: Learners will be able to create organized 3D architectural visualizations with accurate models, suitable materials, lighting, camera positions, composition, and clear presentation for design communication.
outcome_jp: 学習者は、正確なモデル、適切な材料、照明、カメラの位置、構成、およびデザインコミュニケーションのための明確なプレゼンテーションを使用して、組織化された3D建築ビジュアライゼーションを作成することができます。

purpose: Build advanced visualization skills by developing detailed models, realistic materials, lighting setups, camera compositions, and polished architectural presentations. Learners work with more complex spaces and learn how to improve visual quality while maintaining accuracy to the original design.
purpose_jp: 詳細なモデル、リアルな素材、照明設定、カメラ構成、洗練された建築プレゼンテーションを開発することにより、高度なビジュアライゼーションスキルを構築します。 学習者は、より複雑な空間で作業し、元のデザインの精度を維持しながら、視覚的な品質を向上させる方法を学びます。
learn_info: Learn advanced architectural visualization methods for creating detailed and polished digital scenes. Learners study complex modeling, realistic or presentation-focused materials, advanced lighting, camera composition, environmental details, and rendering refinement. The level focuses on improving the visual quality of architectural images while maintaining accuracy to the original plans and design concepts. Learners explore how lighting, materials, atmosphere, depth, scale, and composition can influence how a building or interior is perceived. They also work with more demanding projects that require several viewpoints and consistent visual treatment. Practical work includes scene preparation, material refinement, lighting adjustments, image composition, and final presentation. The goal is to help learners produce professional-quality visualizations that communicate architectural ideas clearly and convincingly.
outcome: Learners will be able to produce detailed architectural visualizations using advanced modeling, materials, lighting, camera composition, environmental details, rendering, and professional presentation techniques.
outcome_jp: 学習者は、高度なモデリング、材料、照明、カメラ構成、環境の詳細、レンダリング、および専門的なプレゼンテーション技術を使用して、詳細な建築ビジュアライゼーションを生成することができます。

purpose: Develop expert-level ability to produce highly refined architectural visualizations for professional presentations, portfolios, and client communication. The level focuses on advanced visual decision-making, detailed scene development, consistency, and the ability to translate complex design concepts into strong visual presentations.
purpose_jp: 専門の提示、有価証券および顧客コミュニケーションのための非常に精製された建築視覚化を作り出す専門家レベルの機能を開発しなさい。 レベルは、高度な視覚的意思決定、詳細なシーンの開発、一貫性、および強力な視覚的プレゼンテーションに複雑なデザインコンセプトを翻訳する能力に焦点を当てています。
learn_info: Learn expert-level approaches to architectural visualization by developing highly refined visual presentations for complex architecture and interior projects. Learners study advanced scene development, detailed modeling, material realism, lighting direction, camera storytelling, environmental elements, composition, and final image refinement. The level focuses on making high-level visual decisions while maintaining technical accuracy and consistency across an entire project. Learners explore how visualization can support client communication, marketing, presentations, competitions, and professional portfolios. Complex project work requires careful coordination of multiple views, materials, lighting conditions, and design details. Learners also develop their own visual approach while learning how to translate complex architectural concepts into polished images that communicate the intended atmosphere, function, scale, and design quality.
outcome: Learners will be able to create highly refined architectural visualizations for complex projects while maintaining technical accuracy, consistent visual quality, detailed scenes, strong composition, and clear design communication.
outcome_jp: 学習者は、技術的な精度、一貫した視覚的品質、詳細なシーン、強力な構成、明確なデザインコミュニケーションを維持しながら、複雑なプロジェクトのための高度に洗練された建築ビジュアライゼーションを作成することができます。

purpose: Understand the basic principles of landscape and garden design, including site planning, planting, pathways, seating, materials, sunlight, and the relationship between buildings and outdoor spaces. The level introduces learners to the main elements used to organize simple gardens and outdoor areas.
purpose_jp: 敷地計画、植栽、通路、座席、材料、日光、建物と屋外スペースの関係など、景観と庭園の設計の基本原則を理解します。 レベルは、単純な庭園や屋外エリアを整理するために使用される主な要素に学習者を紹介します。
learn_info: Learn the basic principles of landscape and garden design, including site planning, planting, pathways, seating, materials, water features, sunlight, and outdoor circulation. Learners study how gardens and landscape areas are organized around practical use, natural conditions, and visual balance. The level introduces basic plant selection, simple garden layouts, relationships between buildings and outdoor spaces, and the role of open areas in creating comfortable environments. Learners also explore how climate, soil, sunlight, and existing vegetation can influence design decisions. Simple exercises help learners understand how to divide an outdoor site into useful areas and arrange basic landscape elements. The focus is on developing clear and practical outdoor spaces while gaining familiarity with the main principles used in garden and landscape planning.
outcome: Learners will be able to create basic garden and landscape layouts using site conditions, planting, pathways, seating, materials, sunlight, circulation, and relationships between buildings and outdoor areas.
outcome_jp: 学習者は、敷地条件、植栽、経路、座席、材料、日光、循環、建物と屋外エリアの関係を使用して、基本的な庭と風景のレイアウトを作成することができます。

purpose: Develop the ability to plan functional gardens and landscape spaces by considering site conditions, user needs, planting, circulation, materials, climate, and relationships between indoor and outdoor areas. Learners begin developing complete landscape concepts for practical projects.
purpose_jp: 敷地条件、ユーザーのニーズ、植栽、循環、材料、気候、屋内と屋外の関係を考慮して、機能的な庭園や景観空間を計画する能力を開発します。 学習者は実用的なプロジェクトのための完全な景色の概念を開発し始める。
learn_info: Learn how to plan complete gardens and landscape spaces by considering site conditions, user requirements, planting, circulation, materials, climate, sunlight, and relationships with surrounding architecture. Learners study how different landscape elements can work together to create functional and visually balanced outdoor environments. The level introduces more detailed planting plans, pathway layouts, seating areas, material selection, garden zones, and transitions between indoor and outdoor spaces. Learners also explore how seasonal changes and maintenance requirements can influence plant and material choices. Practical projects help learners develop landscape concepts for residential gardens and other small outdoor spaces. The focus is on making independent planning decisions and creating outdoor environments that respond to both the natural setting and the needs of the people who use them.
outcome: Learners will be able to develop practical landscape concepts by considering user needs, planting, circulation, climate, sunlight, materials, site conditions, and connections between indoor and outdoor spaces.
outcome_jp: 学習者が実際の景観概念を考慮してユーザーニーズ、植栽循環、気候、太陽光、材料、サイトの状況、および接続屋内外空間です。

purpose: Build advanced landscape design skills through more complex site planning, planting strategies, material selection, spatial organization, environmental conditions, and integration with architecture. The level focuses on creating cohesive outdoor environments with stronger design and functional relationships.
purpose_jp: より複雑なサイト計画、植栽戦略、材料選択、空間構成、環境条件、および建築との統合を通じて、高度なランドスケープデザインスキルを構築します。 レベルはより強い設計および機能関係と凝集の屋外の環境の作成に焦点を合わせる。
learn_info: Learn advanced landscape and garden design through more complex site planning, planting strategies, spatial organization, materials, environmental conditions, and integration with architecture. Learners study how different outdoor areas can be connected through pathways, planting, level changes, views, seating, and carefully planned transitions. The level explores more detailed relationships between vegetation, climate, sunlight, soil, water, maintenance, and user experience. Learners work with larger or more demanding sites and develop complete landscape concepts that require several elements to be coordinated. They also examine how landscape design can improve the relationship between buildings and their natural surroundings. Project work focuses on developing detailed plans, material selections, planting concepts, visual references, and clear design presentations.
outcome: Learners will be able to develop detailed landscape concepts for complex sites using planting strategies, spatial organization, materials, environmental conditions, circulation, and integration with surrounding architecture.
outcome_jp: 学習者は、植栽戦略、空間構成、材料、環境条件、循環、および周囲の建築との統合を使用して、複雑なサイトの詳細な景観概念を開発することができます。

purpose: Develop expert-level ability to create sophisticated landscape and garden concepts for complex sites while balancing environmental conditions, planting, architecture, user experience, maintenance, and visual identity. The level prepares learners to make high-level landscape design decisions and develop original outdoor spaces.
purpose_jp: 環境条件、植栽、建築、ユーザーエクスペリエンス、メンテナンス、および視覚的アイデンティティのバランスをとりながら、複雑なサイトの洗練された風景や庭の概念を作成するための専門家レベルの能力を開発します。 レベルは、高レベルのランドスケープデザインの決定を下し、オリジナルの屋外スペースを開発するために学習者を準備します。
learn_info: Learn expert-level approaches to landscape and garden design by developing sophisticated outdoor environments for complex sites. Learners study advanced relationships between architecture, planting, climate, terrain, materials, water, circulation, views, maintenance, and user experience. The level focuses on creating original landscape directions that respond to the character and requirements of a site rather than following a fixed style. Learners work with complex planning conditions and make independent decisions about planting strategies, spatial hierarchy, material quality, environmental response, and long-term usability. Expert projects also require strong coordination between landscape elements and architectural spaces. Learners develop professional-level documentation and presentations that communicate the complete landscape concept and demonstrate clear reasoning behind major design and environmental decisions.
outcome: Learners will be able to create sophisticated landscape and garden designs for complex sites while balancing planting, architecture, environment, terrain, maintenance, user experience, materials, and long-term functionality.
outcome_jp: 学習者は、植栽、建築、環境、地形、メンテナンス、ユーザーエクスペリエンス、材料、および長期的な機能のバランスをとりながら、複雑なサイトの洗練された風景や庭のデザインを作成することができます。

purpose: Understand the basic stages of fashion design and creative direction, including research, inspiration, mood boards, color, silhouettes, fabrics, styling, and collection planning. The level introduces learners to how individual creative ideas can be developed into simple fashion concepts.
purpose_jp: リサーチ、インスピレーション、ムードボード、カラー、シルエット、ファブリック、スタイリング、コレクション計画など、ファッションデザインとクリエーティブディレクションの基本的な段階を理解します。 レベルは、個々の創造的なアイデアは、単純なファッションの概念に開発することができますどのように学習者を紹介します。
learn_info: Learn the basic process of fashion design and creative direction, including research, inspiration, mood boards, color palettes, silhouettes, fabrics, garment ideas, styling, and collection planning. Learners study how a simple fashion idea can develop into a clear visual concept. The level introduces basic fashion research methods and shows how references can be collected and organized before design development begins. Learners explore how colors, shapes, materials, and styling choices influence the overall appearance of a collection. Simple exercises help learners develop individual garment ideas and understand how several pieces can work together. The focus is on building a strong foundation in fashion design while learning how to communicate creative ideas through sketches, visual references, mood boards, and basic collection presentations.
outcome: Learners will be able to develop basic fashion concepts using research, inspiration, mood boards, color palettes, silhouettes, fabrics, garment ideas, styling, and simple collection planning.
outcome_jp: 学習者は、リサーチ、インスピレーション、ムードボード、カラーパレット、シルエット、ファブリック、衣服のアイデア、スタイリング、シンプルなコレクション計画を使用して、基本的なファッションコンセプトを開発することができます。

purpose: Develop the ability to turn research and inspiration into organized fashion collections by selecting suitable colors, materials, silhouettes, styling elements, and visual references. Learners begin making independent creative decisions and presenting a consistent fashion concept.
purpose_jp: 適切な色、素材、シルエット、スタイリング要素、および視覚的な参照を選択することにより、組織化されたファッションコレクションに研究とイン 学習者は、独立した創造的な意思決定を行い、一貫したファッションコンセプトを提示し始めます。
learn_info: Learn how to develop organized fashion collections by turning research and inspiration into connected garment concepts. Learners study silhouettes, color systems, fabric choices, garment details, styling, collection structure, and visual presentation. The level introduces methods for creating a consistent design direction across several garments while still allowing variation within the collection. Learners explore how target audiences, seasons, occasions, and cultural or visual references can influence design decisions. Practical projects involve developing mood boards, design sketches, material references, color palettes, and collection plans. Learners also study how to explain their creative choices and present a collection clearly. The focus is on moving from individual fashion ideas toward a complete and coherent collection with a clear identity and practical design direction.
outcome: Learners will be able to develop organized fashion collections by combining research, silhouettes, fabrics, colors, styling, garment concepts, audience requirements, and a consistent visual direction.
outcome_jp: 学習者は、研究、シルエット、生地、色、スタイリング、衣服の概念、観客の要件、一貫した視覚的な方向性を組み合わせることによって、組織化されたファッシ

purpose: Build advanced skills in developing complete fashion collections with stronger creative direction, material choices, visual identity, styling, research, and presentation. The level focuses on developing concepts that respond to specific audiences, themes, seasons, or professional project requirements.
purpose_jp: より強い創造的な方向、材料の選択、視覚アイデンティティ、スタイルを作ること、研究、および提示の完全な方法コレクションの開発の高度の技術 このレベルでは、特定のオーディエンス、テーマ、季節、または専門的なプロジェクトの要件に対応する概念の開発に焦点を当てています。
learn_info: Learn advanced fashion design and creative direction through complete collection development, deeper research, material exploration, styling, visual identity, and presentation. Learners study how to build a strong relationship between concept, garment design, fabric, color, silhouette, accessories, and overall image. The level introduces more complex collection planning and requires learners to respond to specific audiences, themes, seasons, markets, or project requirements. Learners also explore how cultural references and contemporary influences can be researched and translated into original design ideas. Advanced projects involve developing multiple garments as a connected collection and refining the visual presentation through detailed boards, sketches, material studies, styling concepts, and final direction. The focus is on stronger creative decisions and a more professional approach to collection development.
outcome: Learners will be able to develop complete fashion collections with stronger creative direction, detailed research, material choices, styling, visual identity, collection structure, and professional presentation.
outcome_jp: 学習者は、より強力な創造的な方向性、詳細な研究、材料の選択、スタイリング、視覚的なアイデンティティ、コレクション構造、およびプロのプレゼンテーションで完全なファッションコレクションを開発することができるようになります。

purpose: Develop expert-level ability to establish original fashion directions and lead complex collection concepts from research through final presentation. The level focuses on creative leadership, strong visual identity, strategic decision-making, and the ability to connect design, styling, materials, and presentation into a complete professional direction.
purpose_jp: 独自のファッションの方向性を確立し、研究から最終プレゼンテーションまでの複雑なコレクションの概念をリードする専門家レベルの能力を レベルは創造的なリーダーシップ、強い視覚アイデンティティ、戦略的な意思決定、および完全な専門の方向に設計、スタイルを作ること、材料および提示を接続する機能に焦点を合わせる。
learn_info: Learn expert-level fashion design and creative direction through original collection development, advanced research, visual identity, material decisions, styling, and complete creative planning. Learners study how to establish a strong fashion direction that can guide garments, accessories, imagery, presentation, and communication across an entire project. The level focuses on independent creative leadership and the ability to make complex decisions when balancing design quality, audience expectations, cultural references, materials, production considerations, and visual identity. Learners develop complete collections and refine their presentation for professional contexts. Expert work also explores how a designer or creative director can establish a recognizable point of view while maintaining consistency across different parts of a fashion project and communicating the final direction clearly to clients, teams, or creative partners.
outcome: Learners will be able to establish original fashion directions and lead complex collection concepts while connecting design, materials, styling, visual identity, audience needs, and creative presentation.
outcome_jp: 学習者は、デザイン、素材、スタイリング、視覚的アイデンティティ、視聴者のニーズ、創造的なプレゼンテーションを接続しながら、独自のファッションの方向性を確立し、複雑なコレクションのコンセプトをリードすることができます。

purpose: Understand the basic principles of fashion illustration, including figure proportions, poses, garment shapes, line, color, texture, and simple digital drawing techniques. The level introduces learners to the visual methods used to communicate clothing and fashion ideas through illustration.
purpose_jp: 図のプロポーション、ポーズ、衣服の形、線、色、テクスチャ、シンプルなデジタル描画技術など、ファッションイラストの基本原則を理解します。 このレベルでは、イラストを通じて衣類やファッションのアイデアを伝えるために使用される視覚的な方法に学習者を紹介します。
learn_info: Learn the foundations of fashion illustration and digital design, including figure proportions, poses, garment shapes, line quality, color, texture, fabric representation, and basic digital drawing tools. Learners study how to draw simple fashion figures and communicate clothing ideas clearly through illustration. The level introduces basic body proportions, garment silhouettes, folds, textures, and the relationship between clothing and the human figure. Learners also explore simple digital workflows such as layers, brushes, selections, and color adjustments. Practice exercises help learners develop confidence in drawing different garments and presenting them in an organized way. The focus is on understanding the visual language of fashion illustration and building the basic skills needed to communicate design ideas through traditional or digital artwork.
outcome: Learners will be able to create basic fashion illustrations using figure proportions, poses, garment shapes, line, color, texture, fabric representation, and simple digital drawing techniques.
outcome_jp: 学習者は、図のプロポーション、ポーズ、衣服の形、線、色、質感、生地の表現、および簡単なデジタル描画技術を使用して、基本的なファッションイラストを作成

purpose: Develop the ability to create clearer fashion illustrations by improving figure drawing, garment construction, fabric representation, color, composition, and digital workflow. Learners begin producing illustrations that can support design development, mood boards, presentations, and portfolios.
purpose_jp: 図の描画、衣服の構造、生地の表現、色、構成、およびデジタルワークフローを改善することにより、より明確なファッションイラストを作成する能力を開発 学習者は、デザイン開発、ムードボード、プレゼンテーション、およびポートフォリオをサポートできるイラストの作成を開始します。
learn_info: Learn how to create clearer and more detailed fashion illustrations by improving figure drawing, garment construction, fabric representation, color, composition, and digital techniques. Learners study how different fabrics behave on the body and how line, shading, texture, and color can communicate their appearance. The level introduces more detailed poses, garment structures, styling elements, and digital workflows. Learners practice creating illustrations for fashion concepts, mood boards, design presentations, and portfolios. They also explore how to organize multiple illustrations as part of a collection or visual story. Practical projects help learners develop a consistent process from rough sketch to refined illustration while improving their ability to communicate clothing, styling, and design details accurately and attractively.
outcome: Learners will be able to create clearer fashion illustrations with improved figure drawing, garment construction, fabric textures, color, composition, styling, and digital illustration workflows.
outcome_jp: 学習者は、図の描画、衣服の構造、生地のテクスチャ、色、構成、スタイリング、およびデジタルイラストのワークフローを改善して、より明確なファッシ

purpose: Build advanced fashion illustration skills through detailed garment representation, expressive poses, fabric textures, complex styling, digital techniques, and stronger visual composition. The level focuses on producing refined illustrations suitable for more demanding creative and professional projects.
purpose_jp: 詳細な衣服表現、表現力豊かなポーズ、生地のテクスチャ、複雑なスタイリング、デジタルテクニック、および強力な視覚的構成を通じて、高度なファッシ レベルは、より要求の厳しい創造的で専門的なプロジェクトに適した洗練されたイラストの制作に焦点を当てています。
learn_info: Learn advanced fashion illustration and digital design through detailed garment representation, expressive figure work, complex styling, fabric textures, color development, and refined digital workflows. Learners study how to communicate sophisticated clothing designs through accurate construction, controlled line work, shading, texture, and composition. The level introduces more complex poses, layered garments, accessories, and visual arrangements while encouraging stronger personal decisions about style. Learners also explore how fashion illustrations can support collection development, editorial work, presentations, and professional portfolios. Advanced projects require learners to create polished illustrations from initial references through final artwork and to maintain visual consistency across a series. The focus is on improving technical control, visual communication, and the ability to produce refined fashion artwork for demanding creative projects.
outcome: Learners will be able to produce refined fashion illustrations using detailed garment representation, expressive poses, complex styling, fabric textures, color development, and advanced digital techniques.
outcome_jp: 学習者は、詳細な衣服表現、表現力豊かなポーズ、複雑なスタイリング、生地の質感、色の開発、および高度なデジタル技術を使用して、洗練されたファッションイラストレーターを作成することができます。

purpose: Develop expert-level ability to create distinctive fashion illustration styles and sophisticated visual presentations for professional fashion projects. The level focuses on advanced figure work, garment interpretation, digital techniques, creative direction, and developing a recognizable personal visual approach.
purpose_jp: 専門の方法プロジェクトのための特有な方法実例様式そして洗練された視覚提示を作成する専門家レベルの機能を開発しなさい。 レベルは、高度な図の仕事、衣服の解釈、デジタル技術、創造的な方向性、および認識可能な個人的な視覚的アプローチの開発に焦点を当てています。
learn_info: Learn expert-level fashion illustration and digital design through advanced figure work, garment interpretation, visual storytelling, creative direction, and development of a recognizable illustration approach. Learners study how to establish a distinctive visual language while maintaining accurate representation of clothing, materials, styling, and fashion concepts. The level explores complex compositions, expressive poses, detailed fabrics, advanced digital techniques, and professional presentation. Learners develop complete illustration series that can communicate a fashion collection, editorial concept, campaign, or creative direction. Expert projects require independent decisions about style, composition, color, technique, and visual identity. The focus is on producing sophisticated and original fashion illustrations that demonstrate strong technical ability while communicating a clear creative point of view.
outcome: Learners will be able to create distinctive professional fashion illustrations with advanced figure work, garment interpretation, visual storytelling, creative direction, digital skills, and a recognizable personal approach.
outcome_jp: 学習者は、高度な図の仕事、衣服の解釈、視覚的なストーリーテリング、創造的な方向性、デジタルスキル、および認識可能な個人的なアプローチで独特のプロのファッションイラストを作成することができるようになります。

purpose: Understand the basic principles of textile and surface pattern design, including motifs, repetition, scale, composition, color, texture, and pattern placement. The level introduces learners to how individual visual elements can be developed into simple patterns for fabrics and other surfaces.
purpose_jp: 基本原則を理解するとともに繊維の表面パターン設計を含め、モチーフの繰り返し、規模、構成、色、質感、パターンを配置。 このレベルでは、個々の視覚要素を生地やその他の表面の単純なパターンにどのように開発できるかを学習者に紹介します。
learn_info: Learn the basic principles of textile and surface pattern design, including motifs, repetition, scale, composition, color, texture, and pattern placement. Learners study how simple visual elements can be developed into organized patterns for fabrics, clothing, interiors, packaging, and other surfaces. The level introduces basic pattern structures, repeat types, simple motif development, and color combinations. Learners explore references from nature, geometry, traditional crafts, and everyday objects while learning how to simplify them into usable design elements. Simple exercises help learners understand spacing, balance, and visual rhythm. The focus is on developing a strong foundation in surface design and understanding how individual motifs can be arranged into patterns that work across different products and materials.
outcome: Learners will be able to create basic textile patterns using motifs, repetition, scale, composition, color, texture, spacing, and simple pattern structures for different surfaces.
outcome_jp: 学習者は、モチーフ、繰り返し、スケール、組成、色、質感、間隔、および異なる表面のための単純なパターン構造を使用して基本的な織物パターンを作成することがで

purpose: Develop the ability to create repeat patterns and organized surface designs by combining motifs, colors, scale, spacing, and composition. Learners begin adapting patterns for clothing, textiles, interiors, packaging, and other practical applications.
purpose_jp: 能力を養を繰り返しパターンと組織の表面のデザインを組み合わせをモチーフに、色、規模、間隔、および組成物。 学習者は、衣類、織物、インテリア、包装、およびその他の実用的なアプリケーションのためのパターンを適応させ始めます。
learn_info: Learn how to create repeat patterns and complete surface designs by combining motifs, colors, scale, spacing, and composition. Learners study different repeat arrangements and how patterns can be adapted to fabrics, clothing, interiors, stationery, packaging, and other applications. The level introduces more detailed motif development, color palettes, pattern variations, and placement methods. Learners practice creating coordinated pattern sets rather than relying on one isolated design. They also explore how the size and density of a pattern can affect its appearance on different surfaces. Practical projects help learners develop organized textile concepts and prepare patterns for specific applications while improving their ability to balance decorative qualities with technical and production requirements.
outcome: Learners will be able to create repeat patterns and surface designs by combining motifs, colors, scale, spacing, composition, and suitable applications for textiles, clothing, interiors, and packaging.
outcome_jp: 学習者は、モチーフ、色、スケール、間隔、構成、および織物、衣類、インテリア、および包装に適したアプリケーションを組み合わせることによって、繰り返しパターン

purpose: Build advanced skills in developing complex textile and surface pattern collections with stronger visual relationships, repeat structures, color systems, scale variations, and material considerations. The level focuses on creating cohesive pattern ranges for specific products or creative projects.
purpose_jp: より強い視覚関係、繰り返しの構造、色システム、スケールの変化および材料の考察の複雑な織物および表面パターンコレクションの開発の高度の技術を レベルは、特定の製品や創造的なプロジェクトのための凝集パターンの範囲を作成することに焦点を当てています。
learn_info: Learn advanced textile and surface pattern design through complex repeat structures, coordinated pattern collections, color systems, scale variations, motif development, and material considerations. Learners study how several patterns can be designed as part of one collection while maintaining a consistent visual identity. The level explores more sophisticated composition, pattern placement, color relationships, surface applications, and adaptation to different textile products. Learners also examine how cultural references, natural forms, and contemporary design influences can be researched and transformed into original patterns. Advanced projects require learners to create multiple coordinated designs and present them through organized pattern boards, color studies, application examples, and repeat layouts. The focus is on developing refined pattern collections suitable for more demanding fashion, textile, interior, and surface design projects.
outcome: Learners will be able to develop coordinated textile pattern collections using complex repeats, color systems, scale variations, motif development, cultural references, and material considerations.
outcome_jp: 学習者は、複雑な繰り返し、カラーシステム、スケールのバリエーション、モチーフの開発、文化的な参照、および材料の考慮事項を使用して調整されたテキスタイルパターンコレクションを開発することができるようになります。

purpose: Develop expert-level ability to create original surface pattern directions and complete textile collections with strong visual identity and professional application. The level focuses on advanced pattern development, creative research, cultural references, technical decisions, and the ability to direct complex surface design projects.
purpose_jp: 強い視覚アイデンティティおよび専門の適用と元の表面パターン方向および完全な織物のコレクションを作成する専門家レベルの機能を開発し レベルは、高度なパターン開発、創造的な研究、文化的な参照、技術的な決定、および複雑な表面設計プロジェクトを指示する能力に焦点を当てています。
learn_info: Learn expert-level textile and surface pattern design through original collection development, advanced pattern systems, creative research, cultural references, color direction, scale, placement, and professional application. Learners study how to establish a complete surface design language that can be applied consistently across multiple products and materials. The level focuses on developing sophisticated repeat structures, coordinated pattern families, distinctive motifs, and strong visual identity while considering practical production requirements. Learners work on complex collections and make independent decisions about research, composition, color, scale, material use, and final application. Expert projects also explore how traditional or cultural references can be interpreted thoughtfully within contemporary pattern design. The focus is on creating original, professional-level surface design collections with clear creative direction and strong application across different products.
outcome: Learners will be able to create original professional surface design collections with advanced pattern systems, creative research, cultural references, color direction, scale, application, and strong visual identity.
outcome_jp: 学習者は、高度なパターンシステム、創造的な研究、文化的な参照、色の方向、スケール、アプリケーション、および強力な視覚的アイデンティティを持つオリジナルのプロのサーフェスデザインコレクションを作成することができます。

purpose: Understand the basic principles of fashion styling, including clothing selection, accessories, color, proportion, texture, and outfit coordination. The level introduces learners to how individual pieces can be combined to create simple and suitable looks for different occasions, themes, and personal styles.
purpose_jp: 服の選択、アクセサリー、色、割合、質感、衣装のコーディネートなど、ファッションスタイリングの基本原則を理解します。 このレベルでは、個々の作品を組み合わせて、さまざまな機会、テーマ、個人的なスタイルに合わせたシンプルで適切な外観を作成する方法を学習者に紹介します。
learn_info: Learn the foundations of fashion styling and image development, including clothing selection, accessories, color, proportion, texture, outfit coordination, and basic styling principles. Learners study how individual garments can be combined into simple and balanced looks for different occasions, audiences, and visual themes. The level introduces mood boards, styling references, basic personal image concepts, and ways to organize fashion ideas before creating a final look. Learners also explore how small details such as footwear, bags, jewelry, layering, and color combinations can change the overall appearance of an outfit. Simple styling exercises help learners understand how to build complete looks and communicate their ideas visually. The focus is on developing a basic understanding of styling and learning how different fashion elements work together.
outcome: Learners will be able to create coordinated fashion looks by selecting suitable clothing, accessories, colors, textures, and proportions for different occasions and visual themes.
outcome_jp: 学習者は、さまざまな機会や視覚的なテーマに適した服、アクセサリー、色、テクスチャ、プロポーションを選択することで、コーディネートされたファッシ

purpose: Develop the ability to create complete fashion looks by combining garments, accessories, colors, textures, and styling details based on a specific concept or audience. Learners begin making independent styling choices and presenting outfits through mood boards, references, and organized visual concepts.
purpose_jp: 特定の概念または聴衆に基づいて衣服、付属品、色、質およびスタイルを作る細部を結合することによって完全な方法一見を作成する機能を開発し 学習者は、独立したスタイリングの選択肢を作り、ムードボード、参照、および組織化された視覚的な概念を介して衣装を提示し始めます。
learn_info: Learn how to create complete and coordinated fashion looks by combining garments, accessories, colors, textures, proportions, and styling details. Learners study how to develop looks around a specific theme, occasion, audience, or visual direction. The level introduces more detailed use of mood boards, styling references, outfit planning, personal image, and visual presentation. Learners explore how clothing choices can affect body proportions, overall balance, and the message communicated by a look. They also study how styling can be adapted for editorial shoots, social media, events, personal branding, and commercial projects. Practical exercises help learners create several coordinated looks and explain the reasoning behind their choices while developing stronger confidence in selecting, combining, and presenting fashion pieces.
outcome: Learners will be able to develop complete styling concepts using mood boards, outfit coordination, accessories, personal image, visual references, and styling choices suited to specific audiences or occasions.
outcome_jp: 学習者は、ムードボード、衣装のコーディネート、アクセサリー、個人的なイメージ、視覚的な参照、および特定の聴衆や機会に適したスタイリングの選択肢を使用して、完全なスタイリングの概念を開発することができるようになります。

purpose: Build advanced styling skills by developing complete image directions that connect clothing, accessories, hair, makeup, setting, color, and overall visual identity. The level focuses on creating more complex styling concepts for editorial, commercial, personal branding, and creative fashion projects.
purpose_jp: 衣服、付属品、毛、構造、設定、色、および全面的な視覚アイデンティティを接続する完全なイメージの方向の開発によって高度のスタイルを作る技術を造 レベルは編集、商業、個人的な決め付けること、および創造的な方法プロジェクトのためのより複雑なスタイルを作る概念の作成に焦点を合わせる。
learn_info: Learn advanced fashion styling and image development through complete visual concepts that connect clothing, accessories, hair, makeup, location, lighting, color, and overall image direction. Learners study how professional styling decisions can support a specific creative message and create consistency across a complete visual project. The level covers detailed research, mood boards, styling plans, outfit coordination, visual references, and preparation for photography or other forms of presentation. Learners also explore how to adapt styling for editorial, commercial, personal branding, campaign, and creative projects. Advanced exercises require learners to develop stronger visual narratives and make independent decisions about garments, proportions, textures, colors, and supporting elements. The focus is on creating polished and cohesive image concepts with a clear creative purpose.
outcome: Learners will be able to create polished fashion image concepts by coordinating clothing, accessories, hair, makeup, location, lighting, color, and overall visual direction for professional projects.
outcome_jp: 学習者は専門のプロジェクトのための衣類、付属品、毛、構造、位置、照明、色および全面的な視覚方向の調整によって磨かれた方法イメージの概念を作成

purpose: Develop expert-level ability to create and direct sophisticated fashion images with a clear visual identity and strong creative purpose. The level focuses on professional styling decisions, creative direction, image development, team coordination, and the ability to establish distinctive fashion presentations.
purpose_jp: 明確な視覚的アイデンティティと強力な創造的な目的で洗練されたファッションイメージを作成し、指示する専門家レベルの能力を開発します。 レベルは、プロのスタイリングの決定、創造的な方向性、画像開発、チームの調整、および独特のファッションプレゼンテーションを確立する能力に焦点を当てています。
learn_info: Learn expert-level fashion styling and image development through sophisticated creative direction, visual identity, styling systems, and complete image projects. Learners study how to establish a distinctive visual language that connects clothing, accessories, beauty, location, photography, and presentation. The level explores advanced research, concept development, styling strategy, team coordination, production planning, and professional communication. Learners work with complex briefs and develop complete visual directions for editorial, commercial, campaign, personal branding, or creative projects. They also study how to maintain consistency across multiple looks while allowing enough variation to support a larger story or collection. Expert projects focus on independent creative leadership, strong visual judgment, problem-solving, and the ability to direct a complete fashion image from initial concept through final presentation.
outcome: Learners will be able to direct sophisticated fashion styling projects with a clear visual identity, consistent image direction, professional styling decisions, team coordination, and strong creative judgment.
outcome_jp: 学習者は、明確な視覚的アイデンティティ、一貫したイメージの方向性、専門的なスタイリングの決定、チームの調整、強力な創造的な判断を持つ洗練されたファッションスタイリングプロジェクトを指示することができるようになります。

purpose: Understand the basic ideas behind sustainable fashion, including responsible materials, waste reduction, durability, reuse, recycling, sourcing, and product life. The level introduces learners to the environmental considerations involved in designing and producing clothing and textile products.
purpose_jp: 責任ある素材、廃棄物の削減、耐久性、再利用、リサイクル、調達、製品寿命など、持続可能なファッションの背後にある基本的な考え方を理解します。 このレベルでは、衣料品や繊維製品の設計と生産に関わる環境への配慮について学習者に紹介します。
learn_info: Learn the basic principles of sustainable fashion and material innovation, including responsible materials, waste reduction, durability, reuse, recycling, sourcing, and product life. Learners study how the materials and production methods used in clothing and textiles can affect environmental performance. The level introduces common sustainable practices and helps learners understand why material selection is an important part of responsible fashion design. Learners explore basic differences between natural, recycled, regenerated, and synthetic materials while considering factors such as durability, comfort, availability, and use. Simple examples help learners understand how designers can reduce unnecessary waste and consider longer product life. The focus is on building a clear foundation in sustainable fashion and understanding how environmental considerations can be included in everyday design decisions.
outcome: Learners will be able to identify sustainable fashion practices and understand how materials, sourcing, production, waste, durability, reuse, and recycling affect fashion products.
outcome_jp: 学習者は、持続可能なファッションの実践を特定し、材料、調達、生産、廃棄物、耐久性、再利用、リサイクルがファッション製品にどのように影響するかを理解することができます。

purpose: Develop the ability to apply sustainable thinking when selecting materials, planning products, reducing waste, and considering production and product use. Learners begin comparing different approaches and making practical design decisions that balance appearance, comfort, quality, cost, and environmental considerations.
purpose_jp: 材料の選択、製品の計画、廃棄物の削減、生産と製品の使用を検討する際に、持続可能な思考を適用する能力を開発します。 学習者は、さまざまなアプローチを比較し、外観、快適性、品質、コスト、環境への配慮のバランスをとる実用的な設計上の決定を行い始めます。
learn_info: Learn how to apply sustainable thinking to fashion and textile projects by considering material selection, production methods, product use, waste, durability, and responsible sourcing. Learners study how different material choices can affect appearance, comfort, performance, cost, and environmental impact. The level introduces practical approaches such as material reuse, repair, recycling, efficient cutting, reduced waste, and longer product life. Learners also explore how sustainability can be considered during concept development rather than added after a design is completed. Through project work, learners compare different materials and production approaches and make practical choices based on specific project requirements. The focus is on developing fashion concepts that balance creative quality, functionality, customer needs, production realities, and responsible use of resources.
outcome: Learners will be able to apply sustainable principles when selecting materials and planning fashion products while balancing environmental impact, comfort, quality, appearance, cost, and production needs.
outcome_jp: 学習者は、環境への影響、快適さ、品質、外観、コスト、および生産ニーズのバランスをとりながら、材料を選択し、ファッション製品を計画する際に持続可能な原則を適用することができるようになります。

purpose: Build advanced skills in developing fashion and textile concepts that integrate sustainable materials, responsible production, durability, circular approaches, and resource efficiency. The level focuses on evaluating different material and production choices and applying sustainability throughout the design process.
purpose_jp: 持続可能な素材、責任ある生産、耐久性、循環的アプローチ、および資源効率を統合するファッションとテキスタイルのコンセプトを開発する高度なスキルを構築します。 このレベルでは、さまざまな材料と生産の選択肢を評価し、設計プロセス全体で持続可能性を適用することに焦点を当てています。
learn_info: Learn advanced sustainable fashion and material innovation through more detailed research into materials, production systems, durability, circular design, resource efficiency, and product life. Learners study how sustainability can influence the full fashion design process, from concept and sourcing to production, use, repair, reuse, and end-of-life considerations. The level explores material performance, responsible sourcing, waste reduction, recycled and alternative materials, and strategies for improving product longevity. Learners evaluate different approaches and consider trade-offs between environmental impact, cost, appearance, comfort, quality, and production requirements. Advanced projects involve developing fashion or textile concepts with clear sustainability goals and documenting the reasoning behind material and production decisions. The focus is on creating practical and well-considered solutions for more complex fashion projects.
outcome: Learners will be able to develop fashion concepts using sustainable materials, responsible production methods, circular approaches, durability, waste reduction, and lifecycle considerations.
outcome_jp: 学習者は、持続可能な材料、責任ある生産方法、循環アプローチ、耐久性、廃棄物の削減、およびライフサイクルの考慮事項を使用してファッションの概念を

purpose: Develop expert-level ability to guide sustainable fashion and material innovation across complex projects while balancing environmental impact, performance, aesthetics, cost, production, and product life. The level focuses on developing responsible design strategies and making high-level decisions about materials and fashion systems.
purpose_jp: 環境への影響、パフォーマンス、美学、コスト、生産、製品寿命のバランスをとりながら、複雑なプロジェクト全体で持続可能なファッションと素材の革新を導く専門家レベルの能力を開発します。 このレベルでは、責任あるデザイン戦略の開発と、素材やファッションシステムに関する高レベルの意思決定に焦点を当てています。
learn_info: Learn expert-level approaches to sustainable fashion and material innovation by developing complete strategies for responsible fashion products and systems. Learners study advanced material research, circular design, lifecycle thinking, responsible sourcing, production efficiency, durability, repair, reuse, recycling, and resource management. The level focuses on making high-level decisions when environmental goals must be balanced with aesthetics, performance, cost, consumer expectations, and manufacturing requirements. Learners develop original material and product concepts and evaluate how sustainability can influence the complete lifecycle of a fashion product. Expert projects require independent research, critical comparison of different approaches, and clear documentation of design decisions. The focus is on developing professional-level sustainable fashion strategies that can guide complex products, collections, or material innovation projects.
outcome: Learners will be able to develop professional sustainable fashion strategies while balancing environmental goals with aesthetics, performance, cost, production requirements, consumer expectations, and product lifecycle.
outcome_jp: 学習者は、環境目標と美学、パフォーマンス、コスト、生産要件、消費者の期待、製品ライフサイクルのバランスをとりながら、専門的な持続可能なファッション戦略を開発することができます。

purpose: Understand the basic foundations of Japanese culinary arts, including common ingredients, preparation methods, cooking techniques, seasonality, balance, simplicity, and food presentation. The level introduces learners to the principles and traditions that shape Japanese cooking and helps them build confidence with basic preparations.
purpose_jp: 一般的な食材、調理方法、調理技術、季節性、バランス、シンプルさ、食べ物の提示など、日本の料理芸術の基本的な基礎を理解します。 このレベルでは、日本の料理を形作る原則と伝統を学習者に紹介し、基本的な準備に自信をつけるのに役立ちます。
learn_info: Learn the foundations of Japanese culinary arts, including common ingredients, preparation methods, cooking techniques, seasoning, seasonality, balance, simplicity, and food presentation. Learners study how Japanese cooking places importance on ingredient quality, careful preparation, timing, and visual presentation. The level introduces commonly used ingredients such as rice, noodles, vegetables, seafood, soy-based products, and basic seasonings. Learners explore simple preparation and cooking methods while becoming familiar with the structure of Japanese meals and the role of seasonal ingredients. Basic presentation principles are also introduced so learners can understand how appearance contributes to the dining experience. Practical cooking exercises help learners develop confidence with essential techniques and understand the cultural ideas that influence Japanese food preparation.
outcome: Learners will be able to prepare basic Japanese dishes using suitable ingredients, preparation methods, cooking techniques, seasoning, timing, seasonality, and simple presentation principles.
outcome_jp: 学習者は、適切な食材、準備方法、調理技術、調味料、タイミング、季節性、簡単なプレゼンテーションの原則を使用して、基本的な日本料理を準備することがで

purpose: Develop the ability to prepare a wider range of Japanese dishes while applying appropriate ingredients, cooking methods, seasoning, timing, and presentation techniques. Learners begin understanding how different elements of a meal work together and how traditional methods can be applied in practical cooking.
purpose_jp: 適切な食材、調理方法、調味料、タイミング、プレゼンテーション技術を適用しながら、より広い範囲の日本料理を準備する能力を開発します。 学習者は、食事のさまざまな要素がどのように連携し、伝統的な方法を実用的な料理にどのように適用できるかを理解し始めます。
learn_info: Learn how to prepare a wider range of Japanese dishes while applying appropriate ingredients, preparation methods, cooking techniques, seasoning, timing, and presentation. Learners study how different components of a Japanese meal can work together through balance of flavor, texture, temperature, color, and seasonality. The level introduces more detailed ingredient preparation and cooking methods and encourages learners to improve consistency and organization in the kitchen. Learners also explore traditional approaches to food presentation and how dishes can be arranged with care and simplicity. Practical projects involve preparing complete dishes or meal combinations while making independent choices about ingredients and presentation. The focus is on developing reliable cooking skills and a stronger understanding of Japanese culinary traditions.
outcome: Learners will be able to prepare a wider range of Japanese dishes while applying appropriate techniques, seasoning, timing, ingredient preparation, meal balance, and traditional presentation methods.
outcome_jp: 学習者は、適切な技術、調味料、タイミング、成分の準備、食事のバランス、伝統的なプレゼンテーション方法を適用しながら、より広い範囲の日本料理を準備することができます。

purpose: Build advanced Japanese culinary skills through more detailed preparation, ingredient handling, cooking control, menu balance, presentation, and traditional techniques. The level focuses on improving consistency, precision, organization, and understanding of the cultural practices connected with Japanese food.
purpose_jp: の構築高度な日本料理の技を通じてより詳細な成成分の取り扱い、お料理制御、メニューバランスの発表、伝統的な技法です。 のレベルを向上の整合性、精度、組織の文化的慣行を接続します。
learn_info: Learn advanced Japanese culinary techniques through detailed ingredient preparation, cooking control, seasoning, timing, menu balance, presentation, and traditional practices. Learners study how professional-level consistency can be achieved through careful preparation, accurate cooking, efficient organization, and attention to small details. The level explores more complex dishes and combinations while examining how seasonality, texture, color, temperature, and presentation contribute to a complete dining experience. Learners also study traditional methods and the cultural context behind selected culinary practices. Advanced projects require learners to plan and prepare multiple dishes while maintaining consistency and quality across the complete meal. The focus is on improving technical precision, refining presentation, and developing stronger judgment in Japanese culinary preparation.
outcome: Learners will be able to prepare more complex Japanese dishes with improved technical precision, consistency, ingredient handling, menu balance, timing, and refined presentation.
outcome_jp: 学習者は、技術的な精度、一貫性、食材の取り扱い、メニューのバランス、タイミング、洗練されたプレゼンテーションを改善して、より複雑な日本料理を準備することができるようになります。

purpose: Develop expert-level ability to plan, prepare, refine, and present sophisticated Japanese culinary concepts while demonstrating strong technical control and cultural understanding. The level focuses on high-level cooking decisions, menu development, presentation, consistency, and professional culinary practice.
purpose_jp: 高度な日本料理のコンセプトを計画、準備、洗練し、提示する専門家レベルの能力を開発し、強力な技術的制御と文化的理解を実証します。 レベルは、高レベルの料理の決定、メニューの開発、プレゼンテーション、一貫性、およびプロの料理の練習に焦点を当てています。
learn_info: Learn expert-level Japanese culinary practice through sophisticated preparation, menu development, ingredient selection, cooking control, presentation, and creative interpretation. Learners study how to develop complete culinary experiences while maintaining a strong understanding of Japanese ingredients, techniques, seasonality, balance, and cultural traditions. The level focuses on precise execution, consistency, efficient kitchen organization, advanced presentation, and the ability to make informed decisions throughout the cooking process. Learners develop original menu concepts and refine dishes according to specific themes, audiences, or dining contexts. Expert projects also require careful consideration of ingredient quality, preparation timing, visual presentation, and overall meal structure. The focus is on developing professional culinary judgment and the ability to create refined Japanese food experiences with a clear and thoughtful direction.
outcome: Learners will be able to develop and execute sophisticated Japanese culinary concepts while demonstrating strong technical control, menu planning, cultural understanding, consistency, and professional presentation.
outcome_jp: 学習者は、強力な技術的制御、メニュー計画、文化的理解、一貫性、および専門的なプレゼンテーションを実証しながら、洗練された日本の料理の概念を開発し、実行することができるようになります。

purpose: Understand the basic ingredients, flavors, cooking methods, and food traditions found across Southeast Asia. The level introduces learners to the diversity of regional cuisines and helps them recognize how herbs, spices, sauces, vegetables, seafood, meats, geography, and local customs influence food.
purpose_jp: 東南アジア全体で見られる基本的な食材、味、調理方法、食の伝統を理解しています。 このレベルでは、地域の料理の多様性を学習者に紹介し、ハーブ、スパイス、ソース、野菜、魚介類、肉、地理、地元の習慣が食品にどのように影響するかを認識するのに役立ちます。
learn_info: Learn the basic ingredients, flavors, cooking methods, and food traditions found across Southeast Asia. Learners explore how herbs, spices, sauces, vegetables, seafood, meats, grains, and other local ingredients are used in regional cooking. The level introduces the differences between cuisines from countries and communities across the region and explains how geography, climate, history, and local customs influence food. Learners study simple preparation and cooking techniques and become familiar with common flavor combinations. The lessons also introduce the cultural importance of food and the role of traditional dishes in everyday life and celebrations. Practical exercises help learners develop basic confidence in preparing and understanding Southeast Asian dishes while recognizing that the region contains many distinct culinary traditions.
outcome: Learners will be able to identify common Southeast Asian ingredients, flavors, cooking methods, regional dishes, and cultural influences while recognizing differences between regional cuisines.
outcome_jp: 学習者は、地域の料理の違いを認識しながら、一般的な東南アジアの食材、味、調理方法、郷土料理、文化的影響を特定することができます。

purpose: Develop the ability to prepare and understand a wider range of Southeast Asian dishes while recognizing differences between regional cuisines. Learners begin applying appropriate ingredients, cooking methods, seasoning, and preparation techniques while developing a stronger understanding of the cultural background of the food.
purpose_jp: 地域の料理の違いを認識しながら、東南アジア料理の広い範囲を準備し、理解する能力を開発します。 学習者は、食品の文化的背景のより強い理解を開発しながら、適切な食材、調理方法、調味料、および調製技術を適用し始めます。
learn_info: Learn how to prepare a wider range of Southeast Asian dishes while understanding differences in ingredients, flavors, cooking methods, and regional traditions. Learners study how herbs, spices, sauces, vegetables, seafood, meats, and other ingredients are combined to create different flavor profiles. The level introduces more detailed preparation methods and encourages learners to compare culinary approaches from different countries and communities. Learners also explore how local ingredients can be substituted when necessary without losing the main character of a dish. Practical projects help learners prepare complete dishes and improve consistency, timing, seasoning, and presentation. The focus is on developing practical cooking skills while building a stronger understanding of the cultural and regional background behind Southeast Asian food.
outcome: Learners will be able to prepare a wider range of Southeast Asian dishes using appropriate ingredients, cooking methods, seasoning, timing, and presentation while understanding regional differences.
outcome_jp: 学習者は、地域の違いを理解しながら、適切な食材、調理方法、調味料、タイミング、プレゼンテーションを使用して、より広い範囲の東南アジア料理を準備することができます。

purpose: Build advanced skills in Southeast Asian culinary practice by working with more complex recipes, regional techniques, ingredient combinations, flavor balance, and menu planning. The level focuses on improving technical consistency while developing a deeper understanding of the differences and connections between regional food traditions.
purpose_jp: より複雑なレシピ、地域の技術、成分の組み合わせ、風味のバランス、およびメニュー計画で作業することにより、東南アジアの料理の練習で高度なスキルを このレベルでは、地域の食の伝統の違いとつながりをより深く理解しながら、技術的な一貫性を向上させることに焦点を当てています。
learn_info: Learn advanced Southeast Asian culinary practice through more complex recipes, regional cooking techniques, ingredient combinations, flavor balance, menu planning, and presentation. Learners study the differences between regional cuisines in greater detail and explore how traditional methods can be adapted to contemporary culinary settings. The level focuses on technical control, ingredient preparation, seasoning, timing, texture, and consistency across more complex dishes. Learners also develop menus that combine dishes thoughtfully while maintaining a clear regional or thematic direction. Advanced projects require learners to research culinary references and make informed decisions about ingredients, cooking methods, and presentation. The focus is on improving technical ability while developing deeper knowledge of Southeast Asian culinary diversity and the relationship between food, place, and culture.
outcome: Learners will be able to develop complex Southeast Asian dishes and menus using regional techniques, ingredient combinations, flavor balance, cultural references, and consistent preparation.
outcome_jp: 学習者は、地域の技術、成分の組み合わせ、風味のバランス、文化的な参照、一貫した準備を使用して、複雑な東南アジア料理やメニューを開発することがで

purpose: Develop expert-level ability to create, refine, and direct sophisticated Southeast Asian culinary concepts while respecting regional identity and traditional knowledge. The level focuses on advanced technique, menu development, cultural understanding, presentation, and professional culinary decision-making.
purpose_jp: 地域のアイデンティティと伝統的な知識を尊重しながら、洗練された東南アジアの料理の概念を作成、洗練、および指示する専門家レベルの能力を レベルは、高度な技術、メニュー開発、文化的理解、プレゼンテーション、およびプロの料理の意思決定に焦点を当てています。
learn_info: Learn expert-level Southeast Asian culinary practice through advanced technique, menu development, regional research, cultural understanding, presentation, and creative direction. Learners study how to develop sophisticated culinary concepts while maintaining respect for the identity and traditions of specific regional cuisines.
